references.text: The Amalekites live in the Negev; the Hittites, Jebusites and Amorites live in the mountains - the Amorites are mentioned as a powerful people in the mountainous regions
The tribe of Dan lost its territory and had to move north to conquer Laish/Leshem, showing that they were pushed out of their original land
The tribe of Dan sought a place to live because they had not yet received their inheritance among the tribes of Israel - a result of being pressed by the Amorites
Dan conquered the city of Laish in the north and renamed it Dan, confirming that they had to move from their original territory
Continuing the description of the Amorites' resistance - they held out at Har-Heres, Aijalon and Shaalbim
The Amorites are mentioned as one of the peoples in the land of Canaan whom God warned Abraham about
